==== GDL Patch by Vizyne ====
by Vizyne



== WHAT THIS DOES ==
- Fixes the inventory names for some items.
	Fire Amulet           -->   Changed from "Weapon" to "Fire Weapon"
	Light Amulet          -->   Changed from "Weapon" to "Light Weapon"
	Acid Amulet           -->   Changed from "Weapon" to "Acid Weapon"
	Electric Amulet       -->   Changed from "Weapon" to "Elec Weapon"

	Gold Invulnerability  -->   Changed from "Invulnerable" to "Gold Invuln"

- Removes delay when opening the inventory.
	(inventory now shows immediately when pressing UP on d-pad)


== KNOWN ISSUES ==
None


== HOW TO USE ==
Just add & enable the code.

AR Code:
